# `mise generate devcontainer`

- **Usage:** `mise generate devcontainer [FLAGS]`
- **Effect:** modifies state
- **Source code:** [`src/cli/generate/devcontainer.rs`](https://github.com/jdx/mise/blob/main/src/cli/generate/devcontainer.rs)

Generate a devcontainer configuration that installs mise

Prints JSON by default. `--write` saves .devcontainer/devcontainer.json in the
repository root (or the current directory outside a git repository), replacing
an existing file. Review the image, mounts, and setup commands before opening it.

## Flags
- **`-i --image <IMAGE>`** — Base image; defaults to mcr.microsoft.com/devcontainers/base:ubuntu
- **`-m --mount-mise-data`** — Keep installed tools in a `mise-data-volume` Docker volume so they survive rebuilds

  Mounts the volume at /mnt/mise-data, sets MISE_DATA_DIR to it, and adds its
  shims directory to PATH.
- **`-n --name <NAME>`** — Container name; defaults to mise
- **`-w --write`** — Write to .devcontainer/devcontainer.json instead of printing
- **`-h --help`** — Print help

## Examples

Print the configuration

```
mise generate devcontainer
```

Keep installed tools in a volume and save .devcontainer/devcontainer.json

```
mise generate devcontainer --mount-mise-data --write
```
